import bpy, math
from collections import Counter
objs = bpy.context.scene.objects
c = Counter(o.name.split(' ')[0] for o in objs)
print(c)
for o in objs:
    if not o.name.startswith('Building'):
        print(o.name, o.type, tuple(round(v,2) for v in o.location), tuple(round(math.degrees(r),1) for r in o.rotation_euler))
cam = bpy.context.scene.camera
print('lens', cam.data.lens)
print('forward', tuple(round(v,3) for v in cam.matrix_world.to_quaternion() @ __import__('mathutils').Vector((0,0,-1))))
hs=[o.dimensions.z for o in objs if o.name.startswith('Building')]
print(len(hs), min(hs), max(hs))
